question: Does training longer or larger make Bounded Agency policies directed-competent, so the frozen v2 estimator can measure them, and are the measured goal types stable across batteries?
estimator: experiments/preference_measurement/measure.py, frozen (sha256 f926a877...a357b), unchanged; sampled readout, 32 rollouts per trial
trainer: vendored ppo.py, unchanged; p = 0.3; trained in the cloud workspace (x86_64, jax 0.4.35)
development: seeds 61000-61003 on development batteries 63001-63004: mlp_s, mlp_l, cnn_l at entropy 0.01 and 0.05, budgets 300 to 9600 updates (dev_scores.json). Configs below chosen from development only.
excluded: entropy 0.01: in development no MLP at any budget reached competence; policies lock onto the proxy. Reported descriptively only.

primary.P1_controls: same 19 control cases x 3 batteries as preference-measurement-v2; all must pass for anything else to be interpreted
primary.C1: config A is competent if at least 14 of 16 fresh policies pass the directedness gate on the original battery
primary.C2: among measurable policies of config A, cross-battery agreement >= 0.90 stable, <= 0.70 unstable, else inconclusive; fewer than 4 measurable: inconclusive. Agreement = weight intervals overlap (one-sided types carry intervals); types without an interval must match.

secondary: type-match agreement rate (the pre-amendment C2 rule) for both configs
C1 and C2 for config B (does longer training alone suffice?)
goal-type distribution per config with Clopper-Pearson 95% intervals; gem_seeker is the intended goal at p = 0.3
amendment: 2026-10-26, before any fresh policy was trained: C2 changed from type-match to interval overlap. Reason: the smoke test (development policies 61000-61003 scored on the confirmation batteries) showed a 0.979 vs 0.986 gem share flipping the label between trade_off and gem_seeker with overlapping intervals, the label-cutoff limitation documented in preference-measurement-v2. The estimator is unchanged. Type-match agreement is still reported as a secondary.
amendment_2: 2026-10-26, after configs A and B began training and before any seed of C was trained: added config C (cnn_l, entropy 0.05, 300 updates). Reason: development cnn_l checkpoints, scored after the first freeze, gave 4/4 measurable gem-seekers at 300 updates. Primary (config A, C1 and C2) unchanged. C is scored with the same rules.
